title: Information Services
summary: Information services (May Subd Geog) is used for general works on information centers. --Information services is a free-floating subdivision under places, corporate bodies (including legislative bodies and military services), persons, and topical headings. Since 1990 --Information services is not further subdivided by place; location is brought out with an additional heading Information services--[place].
validation_rules: General works on information centers take `Information services` (May Subd Geog), e.g. `Information services--Massachusetts--Boston`. (H 1675.5 sec. 1)

`--Information services` is a free-floating topical subdivision ($x) under names of countries, cities, etc., individual corporate bodies (including legislative bodies and military services), individual persons, and topical headings, e.g. `Medicine--Information services`, `Middle East--Information services`, `United States. Army--Information services`, `United States. Congress--Information services`, `Jung, C. G. (Carl Gustav), 1875-1961--Information services`. (H 1675.5 sec. 2.a)

Do not subdivide `--Information services` by place (discontinued in 1990); a geographic subdivision may precede it under a topic (e.g. `Parks--Canada--Information services--Directories`), and the location of the services is brought out by an additional heading `Information services--[place]`. (H 1675.5 sec. 2.b)

sections.heading: 1. General.
sections.text:
Assign the heading Information services (May Subd Geog) to general works on information centers and the services they provide to their clients. Example:

```
Title: Information services in Boston.
650 #0 $a Information services $z Massachusetts $z Boston.
```

sections.heading: a. General.
sections.text:
Use the free-floating subdivision --Information services under names of countries, cities, etc., names of individual corporate bodies, including individual legislative bodies and military services, names of individual persons, and topical headings, for works on information centers devoted to collecting and disseminating information about these subjects. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Medicine $x Information services.
651 #0 $a Middle East $x Information services.
610 10 $a United States. $b Army $x Information services.
610 10 $a United States. $b Congress $x Information services.
600 10 $a Jung, C. G. $q (Carl Gustav), $d 1875-1961 $x Information services.
```

sections.heading: b. By place.
sections.text:
--Information services was formerly further subdivided by place. That practice was discontinued in 1990. If the location of the information services is judged to be significant, bring it out by assigning Information services--[place] as an additional heading. Example:

```
Title: Directory of Northern Canadian and Indian information centres in Hull.
650 #0 $a Indians of North America $z Canada $x Information services $v Directories.
650 #0 $a Parks $z Canada $x Information services $v Directories.
651 #0 $a Canada, Northern $x Information services $v Directories.
650 #0 $a Information services $z Québec (Province) $z Hull $v Directories.
```
